title: Classification metrics: accuracy, precision, recall, F1 and ROC AUC

videos.script: Three hundred and forty-eight credits reached somebody who was leaving. Three hundred and sixty-three did not. {{counts}} Eleven hundred leavers got nothing. Twenty-two thousand stayers were left alone. {{four}} Every classification metric is arithmetic on those four numbers. {{arithmetic}} Accuracy adds up the right answers, and on a rare class it barely moves. {{accuracy}} Precision asks how many credits were worth sending. Recall asks how many leavers were reached. Lower the cut and one rises while the other falls. {{trade}} Then two curves that need no cut at all. The ROC curve, which ranks. And the precision-recall curve, which keeps the rare class in view. {{curves}} By the end, you know which number answers which question. And you have spotted something odd. The cut that makes the most money is not the one the costs predicted. {{end}}
